title: Fuel tape copying
statement:
Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $m$ be either Boolean mode. Choose a host base configuration, an input-head position, a flag tape, an output word, and a remainder word. For every prefix word $p$, start the host in control phase $2$, with the counter and payload tapes and head positions arranged as specified by $p$ and the tape that stores the concatenation of $p$ with the remainder. After $|\mathrm{rest}|+1$ steps, the host is in phase $3$, its counter tape stores $p\mathbin{+
egthinspace+}\mathrm{rest}$ with the prescribed head positions, its payload tape is blank with head at zero, and its other specified components are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
